reference_modes.operand: accumulate at the declared fp32 or fp64 operand precision
reference_modes.fp32: round declared operands, alpha, and beta before FP32 accumulation
reference_modes.fp64: round declared operands, alpha, and beta before FP64 accumulation

nan_inf_policy: reject any non-finite reference or candidate value and report counts separately
degree_depth_policy: report the worst absolute error location and maxima normalized by max(1, degree) and max(1, depth)
alpha_beta_policy: record exact referee alpha and beta in every comparison report
